public_notes.title: Completed Transfer And Announced Access
public_notes.text: The Tribe's July 28, 2026 release reports that Save the Redwoods League conveyed the 'O Rew property to the Tribe on June 30. It separately announces recreational access beginning August 1 and describes a cultural center as a future aim. Those are different kinds of claims: a reported completed transaction, a scheduled opening and planned construction. This release alone does not show whether later access or construction occurred. Ownership, operation, restoration and access each need their own dated evidence; this account is not a title search or a general route for another Nation's claim.

official_resources.label: Yurok Tribe: Transfer, Access And Future Plans
official_resources.purpose: Read the durable July 28, 2026 release. Keep the reported June 30 conveyance separate from announced August 1 access and future construction. Later outcomes are not established by this release alone.
